A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research paper and complete Appendices A–E. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish that pages 2–26 are identical; page 1 differs only in resource links and the arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction and generation experiments, ablations, and a user study in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original experiments, ablations, qualitative demonstrations, and user-study results.

M1.justification: The SLAT representation, sparse VAE, output decoders, two-stage rectified-flow generation, and editing procedures remain identical in Section 3 and Appendix A.

E1.justification: Both retain the same Objaverse-XL, ABO, 3D-FUTURE, and HSSD training sources, Toys4k evaluations, synthetic prompts, and SA-1B real-image examples.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the reconstruction comparison in Table 1, generation comparison in Table 2, and appendix comparisons, including Rodin Gen-1 in Figure 16.

E3.justification: Training settings, model sizes, evaluation samples, rendering procedures, metrics, and user-study design are identical in Section 4 and Appendices A–C.

E4.justification: The latent-size, generation-paradigm, model-size, and timestep-sampling ablations in Tables 3–5 and 7 are unchanged, as are the supplementary editing and scene-composition demonstrations.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including aesthetic-score summaries in Figure 8 and user-study counts and percentages in Table 9. Neither version adds repeated-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples match, including reconstruction and generation scores, ablation outcomes, and user preferences. No result entries, rankings, or reported findings change.

T1.justification: Equations 1–14, representation definitions, training objectives, and mathematical explanations are identical. No theoretical results or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about generation quality, versatile output formats, flexible editing, and fitting-free training.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and applicability discussions are unchanged. Appendix E retains the same limitations concerning two-stage generation efficiency and baked-in lighting in image-conditioned outputs.

D1.justification: Page 1 replaces the project-site link with the Microsoft/TRELLIS GitHub repository link, including the abstract's hyperlink target. This changes resource-access information; implementation details and claims of code, model, and data availability remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, references, and positioning relative to prior research are identical.

P1.justification: The front-page resource URL and arXiv version/date text are updated. The title, authors, prose, section organization, and appendix structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–20 and Tables 1–9 retain identical displays, captions, and placement. The front-page text updates do not alter the surrounding layout.

improvement.justification: The revision updates resource links and version metadata while preserving the scientific content, evidence, explanations, and limitations. Both versions already state that code, models, and data are available; the PDFs establish no additional resource availability or meaningful overall quality difference.
